source: Vihang AI Knowledge Automation System design v1.0
summary: File-based control plane for incremental implementation of document ingestion, RAG API, and Telegram automation on top of the existing Avinya codebase.

reuse_notes: Keep the current Ollama + Chroma + embedding stack unless a task explicitly replaces it.
Treat the current CLI and desktop app as the reference behavior for memory, prompting, and retrieval.
Use the existing markdown-based CKB ingestion flow as the baseline for the new vault/index pipeline.

milestones.name: Control plane
done_when: Task status can be updated without chat context

milestones.name: Document pipeline
done_when: PDF, DOCX, and XLSX inputs convert into structured markdown
Converted output is archived and indexed

milestones.name: RAG service
done_when: FastAPI exposes query, reindex, and health endpoints
Existing retrieval logic is reused or wrapped cleanly

milestones.name: Telegram interface
done_when: Files can be uploaded through Telegram
Admin commands cover health and reindex

tasks.title: Write durable control-plane docs
tasks.scope: Create the markdown master plan, status file, and worklog that Gemini can read after session loss.
verification: Files exist and are readable
Task graph lists the current repo reuse points
Markdown instructions are clear enough for Gemini to execute without chat history

tasks.title: Define converter interfaces and file routing
tasks.scope: Add a base converter contract and a factory that selects PDF/DOCX/XLSX handlers.
reuse_from_repo: utils/chunking.py for downstream text segmentation patterns
verification: Factory returns the expected converter type per extension
Unsupported files fail loudly and predictably

tasks.title: Implement PDF conversion path
tasks.scope: Convert PDF documents into structured markdown with metadata and fallback handling.
inputs: PDF files from inbox or Telegram
verification: Text-only PDF converts successfully
Corrupted or password-protected PDFs are rejected cleanly
Metadata includes source file and conversion method

tasks.title: Implement DOCX and XLSX conversion paths
tasks.scope: Convert office documents into structured markdown tables and sections.
reuse_from_repo: existing markdown and retrieval pipeline assumptions
verification: Multi-section DOCX preserves headings and paragraphs
Multi-sheet XLSX produces readable markdown tables
Empty or invalid office files fail safely

tasks.title: Build inbox watcher and processor
tasks.scope: Watch the inbox directory, process new files, archive originals, and write markdown to the vault.
verification: Dropping a supported file into inbox triggers processing
Original files are archived after successful conversion
Processing failures do not delete source inputs

tasks.title: Add categorization and markdown formatting
tasks.scope: Classify documents into categories and emit standardized markdown with frontmatter.
verification: Filename and content rules map to expected categories
Markdown frontmatter includes title, source, category, and timestamps

tasks.title: Expose RAG service behind FastAPI
tasks.scope: Wrap existing retrieval and generation logic in HTTP endpoints for query, reindex, health, and stats.
verification: POST /query returns answer, sources, and latency
POST /reindex rebuilds the collection
GET /health reports backend status

tasks.title: Add query filtering and reranking
tasks.scope: Support metadata filters and optional reranking on retrieved chunks.
verification: Category filters narrow results
Reranking preserves relevance without losing source traceability

tasks.title: Define Telegram bot integration surface
tasks.scope: Implement bot command handling, file upload intake, and query routing to the RAG service.
verification: Bot receives file uploads
Bot forwards questions to query endpoint
Admin commands return health and reindex responses

tasks.title: Write handover and operations docs
tasks.scope: Document setup, service startup, troubleshooting, and maintenance for a future captain.
reuse_from_repo: existing README-style explanation patterns in code comments and prompts
verification: A new maintainer can bootstrap the system from docs alone
Operational commands are listed with expected outputs
Recovery steps cover index rebuild and service restart

risks: PDF conversion quality may vary by library and document complexity.
The current repo already contains a local RAG stack, so duplicating it would waste time and create drift.
Telegram integration introduces credentials and uptime concerns that should stay isolated from core ingestion code.
The RTX 3050 may require quantized or CPU-backed inference for stable 24/7 operation.
execution_notes: Gemini should update tasks/STATUS.md after each completed task.
Gemini should append decision records to tasks/WORKLOG.md when changing architecture or dependencies.
Use the existing Avinya modules as reference implementation before adding new code paths.
Prefer wrapper modules over rewriting working retrieval and memory logic.
